reading.action: Fall back INTO the stair to evade the Sentinel's slow blow, staying close enough to keep siphoning its flame at range, far enough to be out of its reach.

partA_evade.note: situational +2 = its slowness + the narrowing stair a huge thing can't follow.

partB_siphon_ranged.note: Ember Siphon AT RANGE — no contact point, harder than the t41 contact-drain (DC 17 -> DC 19); offset by the already-opened dimmed seam. Margin 10 = a real but THIN sustained thread, not the substantial tear that ticks affinity.

reading.result: EVASION (margin 22, clean): he breaks cleanly back into the stair, footing sure; the column-limb slams the stone where he stood and hits nothing — the Sentinel is committed/recovering from the big slow swing, its bulk now jammed at the stairmouth, a stair too narrow for it to follow. He gains an ideal perch just out of its reach. RANGE SIPHON (margin 10, solid-thin): he holds a siphon-thread across the gap from the dimmed seam and draws a steady TRICKLE of heat; the seam guts darker, the creature bleeds a little more. RULING (clarification, recorded): affinity ticks on a SUBSTANTIAL absorption (the t41 contact-tear), NOT on incidental trickle-draining -> Ember Manipulation STAYS 4 (the thread builds toward 5 but doesn't complete an event). SKILL DEVELOPMENT: extending Ember Siphon from contact to RANGE under pressure is a genuine new application -> within-Novice roll-up 1 -> 3 (0.5*(5-1)); still Novice (capped; promotion to Apprentice needs a live demo). No System window (within-rung). OVERFILL: he was already brim-full from t41; pulling MORE heat into a body that can't hold it scalds him from the inside -> HP 74 -> 66 (-8 internal scald, a clear warning he needs an OUTLET for the stolen heat). COSTS: Focus 96 -> 82 (-14 willed range-drain), Stamina 51 -> 47 (-4 hard scramble). AMBIENT: the furnace jammed in the stairmouth rolls heat down — the stair itself is heating (added pressure, NOT a new ranged attack). BURNING ANGER lies up at the lip where he set it down (t41), now on the creature's side of the threshold — NOT retrieved (he didn't say); a dart to reclaim it. STOP at his decision point — safe from reach but cooking from within and the rising heat; his move. NO assumed next action. NO Tower reset.
